## Tools & Dashboards

### [SIYA: Sistema de Indicadores de los YA](https://ninezya.org/siya/) (2024)
Monitoring system that tracks indicators of childhood and adolescence for the NiñezYA coalition, including education, health, nutrition, and violence and security. I designed and maintained the indicator system across three releases, building indicators from administrative and survey data with reproducible R and Python code under Git version control (see [code on GitHub](https://github.com/dfmendivelso10/Ninez-YA) and [credits](https://enflujo.github.io/imagina-ninezya/creditos/)).

### [Maternal and Child Health Dashboard](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/maternoinfantil/) (2023)
Impact measurement system for more than 22 maternal and child health indicators, with baselines and targets, across 1,101 Colombian municipalities, developed for Fundación Éxito. I scoped and designed the indicator system, and cleaned and managed the large administrative datasets supporting it (see [credits](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/maternoinfantil/creditos/)).

### [Prevalence and Nature of CSEA: Interactive Data Tool](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/prevalence-csea/) (2025)
Interactive tool on child sexual exploitation and abuse in 17 countries, based on the Violence Against Children and Youth Surveys (VACS). I coded, cleaned, and harmonized the multi-country microdata that powers the tool, and co-built it (see [credits](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/prevalence-csea/#creditos)).

## Working Papers & Reports

### Prevalence and Nature of Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (technical report, in submission)
Multi-country report based on VACS microdata from 17 countries. I coded, cleaned, and harmonized the underlying data.

### Intergenerational transmission of childhood adversity in Colombia (working paper, in preparation)
Study of 163 caregiver–child dyads exploring how Adverse Childhood Experiences are transmitted to child socioemotional outcomes, using mediation analysis within a structural equation framework. Co-author.

### Prevalence and measurement of childhood adversity in Bogotá public services (working paper, in preparation)
Prevalence study of 346 adolescents and young adults across 18 localities, survey-weighted to represent 1.8 million residents, introducing a participatory measurement instrument and using mediation and sensitivity analysis. Co-author.
